assembly.why: observed: 87 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 0 on B, 1 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad that is not a paste/mask aperture (#1143), and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

context.keepouts_note: empty because a keep-out is a mechanical fact -- an enclosure rib, a standoff, a battery, a display window, an antenna clearance -- and none of those can be read off a board. "[]" here means NONE DECLARED, never "not considered". Declare them by hand; since #701 the seat search honours them, not only the grade.
